skill.name: socialdatax-content-research-assistant
skill.description: 面向内容运营、品牌调研和创作者的跨平台社媒内容研究助手。适用于小红书、抖音、快手、Bilibili、知乎、Instagram、X / Twitter、YouTube、TikTok、微博、今日头条、好看视频和视频号的选题策划、竞品观察、趋势判断、评论洞察和创作者资料整理，也支持公众号文章链接详情、内容整理和互动统计，来自 SocialDataX 社媒数据助手。
skill.summary: Research social media topics, comments, creators, and engagement through SocialDataX platform commands.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Of 148 static findings, two confirm unpinned npm execution risks; 146 are Markdown, platform identifier, credential configuration, URL, or language heuristic false positives. A separate finding addresses unconditional disclosure of token-bearing XHS links. No evidence of malicious prompt injection or credential exfiltration was found in the supplied files; external package implementation was unavailable.

remediation.issue: CLI examples execute socialdatax-skills@latest through npx -y without a reviewed version.
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed package version, verify package provenance and dependency integrity, and run with minimal filesystem and credential access.

remediation.issue: XHS output instructions forbid redaction of xsec_token URLs during display, storage, or forwarding.
remediation.suggestion: Keep complete links only in authorized contexts; allow redaction and require consent before publishing or forwarding token-bearing URLs.

content.user_title: Research Social Media Content with SocialDataX
content.value_statement: Social media research requires collecting evidence from different platforms and separating facts from interpretation. This skill guides SocialDataX queries and organizes topics, comments, creator profiles, and engagement signals.
actual_capabilities: Guide platform-specific keyword searches and available hot-list queries through SocialDataX CLI commands or corresponding MCP tools.
Retrieve content details, comments, and paginated replies using supported platform links, identifiers, and continuation tokens.
Collect creator profiles, account search results, and recent content lists where supported.
Research XHS and Douyin products, XHS product reviews, and WeChat article details or engagement statistics.
Organize platform evidence into content angles, audience needs, comment themes, and creator observations.
Preserve partial results and guide continuation within page limits, item limits, and documented rate controls.
limitations: Requires SocialDataX access, a configured API key, network connectivity, and sufficient account balance.
Direct CLI usage requires Node.js and npm; external package behavior is not implemented in the supplied skill files.
Read-only workflows do not log in, publish posts, send comments, like content, or modify accounts.
Platforms support different filters and pagination methods; returned samples do not guarantee complete coverage or representative trends.

use_cases.title: Plan Evidence-Based Content Topics
use_cases.description: Compare available hot-list signals and keyword samples, then identify content angles supported by platform-specific evidence.

use_cases.title: Review Brand Feedback
use_cases.description: Analyze comments and supported product reviews to summarize recurring needs, objections, and questions without treating samples as population estimates.

use_cases.title: Compare Creator Positioning
use_cases.description: Review candidate creator profiles and recent posts to compare topic focus, publishing patterns, and visible engagement signals.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Topic
prompt_templates.prompt: Search XHS for [topic] using one page. Summarize recurring content angles and include returned source references.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner research with a limited sample.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Audience Comments
prompt_templates.prompt: Review comments on [supported content link], stopping after 30 main comments. Separate observed themes from interpretation and mark incomplete reply threads.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Creator Profiles
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare these [platform] creator profiles: [profile links]. Use one content page each and separate profile facts, content evidence, and partnership questions.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Cross-Platform Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research [topic] on XHS, Douyin, and YouTube, with at most two pages per platform. Compare evidence, disclose sampling limits, and preserve partial results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced research with explicit collection limits.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: compare content angles for home workouts across two platforms.
output: XHS sample theme: small-space routines and equipment choices.
Douyin sample theme: short demonstrations and repeatable challenges.
Research angle: compare beginner routines, supported by source references from each platform.
Limit: sampled posts do not establish overall audience preferences.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: summarize feedback from a product review sample.
output: Illustrative review summary, not live findings.
Observed themes: setup questions, size concerns, and requests for comparison examples.
Interpretation: a practical setup guide may address repeated questions.
Next step: inspect complete reply threads before assigning sentiment.
Coverage: report collected review counts and mark any incomplete pages.

best_practices: Set platform, query, page limits, and item limits before collection, and confirm account balance.
Keep evidence separated by platform and distinguish retrieved facts from analytical judgments.
Use a reviewed CLI version, protect API keys, and review token-bearing links before sharing reports.
anti_patterns: Treating a small search sample or hot list as proof of a platform-wide trend.
Reusing pagination tokens across different queries, content items, or reply threads.
Publishing API keys or token-bearing links without reviewing access and disclosure risks.

faq.question: What must I configure before using this skill?
faq.answer: Configure SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY and network access. Direct CLI execution also requires Node.js and npm, and API calls require sufficient SocialDataX balance.

faq.question: Which platforms are covered?
faq.answer: Documented platforms include XHS, Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, Zhihu, Instagram, X, YouTube, TikTok, Weibo, Toutiao, WeChat, and Haokan.

faq.question: Does the skill publish content or change accounts?
faq.answer: The documented workflows are read-only. They do not log in, publish posts, send comments, like content, or modify accounts.

faq.question: Do I need an MCP server?
faq.answer: No additional MCP server is required when your agent can run the documented direct CLI commands. Corresponding MCP tool names are also listed.

faq.question: What happens when a request returns partial results?
faq.answer: Keep retrieved items and errors, then resume with the returned continuation token and original query. Do not automatically restart collection.

faq.question: Can all platforms use the same filters?
faq.answer: No. Supported identifiers, date filters, sorting, and pagination differ by platform. Use only options documented for the selected command.
